 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 5 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You can smell the shift in the air. You know things will be very different in the near future; you know that, while this may not have been on your radar for a long time, this is exactly what you are forging and creating because it feels right now. And you are doing things with all your heart. Not only has your perspective shifted, but it has also softened, towards yourself, towards life, towards everything that feels alive and important to you. Remember, a tug of war can only exist if there are two parties tugging at the rope. What happens if you drop the rope, Leo ? The other party doesn't win; you just decide to use your strength and resources in more fitting and positive ways. That's all. Not everything needs to be spoken or fought over. Not everything needs you to concede or prove a point. The confidence in your own inner self, your capabilities, your strengths, your light and your guides, Aquarius , is what your focal point should be. No matter what you are going through, you must remember that it is not the dark that consumes light; it is the light that consumes darkness. Ultimately, we all only want to feel loved, seen and understood. So do you, Aries . So be the one who goes easy on you first. The world will follow.
 Read on for what the stars have in store for you, and make sure you check out your sun, moon and rising signs for the complete picture.
 Aries Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) It is time you paused that harsh inner dialogue, Aries . Allow healing to set in. You did what you thought was best at one given point in time, and now that you look back, you may feel like you could have done things differently. However, is this how things really should feel? Nope. There are no shoulds in life—only decisions you make that are the best possible ones you can make at any given point, with all the information and perspective you have that has led to that moment. Ultimately, we all only want to feel loved, seen and understood. So do you. So be the one who goes easy on you first. The world will follow.
 Cosmic tip: Open yourself up to the world around you.
 Taurus Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) The cosmos gave you a wild card now, Taurus , whether you throw it in the trash or really play it well is entirely up to you. Has life been a little extra off lately? Of course. For you to fully fathom things, you must know that you are almost at the fag end of it all. Imagine yourself as the director of your own life, the king/queen of your own kingdom, with everything else around and within it being your responsibility. Now you need not crumble under this pressure, but really, how would you like your little empire to feel? How would you be doing right by everything and everyone, including yourself? An elevated perspective is all that is needed for you to pick well.
 Cosmic tip: Shift the role you play in your mind to shift the outcome you create in your life.
 Gemini Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Life has not been easy, for some for 2-3 months, for some for 2-3 years and for some for even longer. That is not the point, Gemini . The point is how wonderfully you have emerged from this. How wonderfully you have grown and evolved. Your outlook on life, your perspective on what matters to you, your heart and your ability to share, process and see various perspectives—it has all evolved with you and turned you into this person you are today. Life feels good because you chose to water it and make it turn out this way. Now it is time to give yourself the same love, care and attention you give others. Call that friend, make that effort to do things that lift you up. You deserve it.
 Cosmic tip: Rebel for your cause, because that is the very essence and flavour that keeps you alive.
 Cancer Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You can smell the shift in the air. You know things will be very different in the near future; you know that while this may not have been on your radar for a long time, this is exactly what you are forging and creating because it feels right now. And you are doing things with all your heart. Not only has your perspective shifted, but it has also softened, towards yourself, towards life, towards everything that feels alive and important to you. You no longer feel like a slave to life; you simply feel like that chapter is gone, and you are ready to sculpt things in ways that feel right to you.
 Cosmic tip: The light of your own magic—that is your true power, and you are now choosing to use it the way that fits well with you.
 Leo Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Leo , if you have been asking, ‘What is my task?’ the cosmos has been giving you opportunities to serve. Have your relationships felt easy? Well, not all of them. The ones that have felt particularly strained or heavy are the ones that are calling out to you to lighten the load. Remember, a tug of war can only exist if there are two parties tugging at the rope. What happens if you drop the rope? The other party doesn't win; you just decide to use your strength and resources in more fitting and positive ways. That's all. Do what you feel you must, but then, remember to do it from your heart. That will be you dropping the rope, and what the opponent says won’t matter all that much anymore.
 Cosmic tip: Come back to your true self.
 Virgo Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your healing is in your hands, and Virgo , here's a little secret: the gentler you are with yourself, the more in tune you are with your creative, intuitive and nurturing inner voice; the easier you will find it to find your way through things. Yes, you have already learnt it the hard way, but your guides offer this as a reinforced reminder today. You have come such a long way to understand yourself, your life, your inner wisdom, your heart and everything else that goes into the mix; now don’t you go mess it up by questioning yourself and trying to be someone you are not! Your softness is your strength, and yes, it is something you work on, reminding yourself every day, but you are on track. Keep going.
 Cosmic tip: Be sincere and fearless—you’ve got fierce backup in the subtle, benevolent realms.
 Libra Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) How much of yourself are you pouring into the superficial, and how much of it are you pouring into what truly matters, Libra ? Real connections need you to show up, no matter what. Real connections need you to nurture them no matter what. Slip-ups are human; getting lost in the routine and grind is also human. But choosing to surface every now and then, to show you are there, is equally human. Make the effort, build and nurture your tribe and know that fresh wind is blowing into your life, and the only thing that will matter is how you choose to show up.
 Cosmic tip: Remember that you have a role you play in your own life too.
 Scorpio Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Life on Earth is a heroic journey, Scorpio , but you must remember that even heroes need rest, love, care and kindness. Take a deep breath and exhale. What is the kindest thing you can do for yourself today? Do it. Don’t answer that call just this time; cut off from content and constant stimulation just for 30 mins, if not more. Go for a short walk without your gadgets, focusing on what you see, feel and hear and not the endless task sheet that is running through your mind. Stay flexible, but also steadfast and firm. You are not to be taken for a ride, just as you would not take anyone for one. Dole yourself out the same equanimity, fairness and kindness as you do to others and remember that you are your responsibility first.
 Cosmic tip: Release guilt, make choices that feel like you are doing right by you.
 Sagittarius Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Get going. Sag , get out of that self-preservatory, self-pity mode and don that magnanimous leadership hat that has got you out of precarious situations in the past. You may have been waiting for your life to pan out in the past, but really, where did that land you? Feeling stuck or trapped. Does this mean you need to rush through things? Nope. But you do need to give them an honest shot, one day at a time, for sure. Release the need for perfection because, as a soul, you are already it. Use your words to create the destiny you want. Not one that you wish to run away from.
 Cosmic tip: Your freedom begins in your thoughts.
 Capricorn Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You have walked through what feels like hell and back. Capricorn , only you could have walked through the fires you did walk through and that too with the smile that you wore so effortlessly. And then you may have needed some downtime. But not anymore. Now is the time to actively and deliberately choose what you want to line up in your future. Your eyes may have become stone cold with all you have been through, but your inner voice, intuition and wisdom are still alive and ticking. Close your eyes and ask yourself how you want your life to feel. When you have a sort of clear understanding, ask your guides and the cosmos to help you understand how you can create it in your reality.
 Cosmic tip: Concede in order to move forward.
 Aquarius Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Softness suits you. Better get used to this. Aquarius , this is the third time in a row that this message is coming forward for you. So it's time you paid attention. Not everything needs to feel like a battle. Not everything needs to be spoken or fought over. Not everything needs you to concede or prove a point. The confidence in your own inner self, your capabilities, your strengths, your light and your guides is what your focal point should be. No matter what you are going through, you must remember that it is not the dark that consumes light; it is the light that consumes darkness. Find your power in this, in yourself, in your life.
 Cosmic tip: Allow your words and smiles to be your adornments.
 Pisces Horoscope Today: November 5, 2026 
 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Your words, energy and intentions hold immense power, Pisces . When you intend to take something on and invest your energy into it, ensure it is with all your heart—not only because it adds value to all you do, but also because this very love and devotion become your shield and protection. Allow your mind to heal, allow your heart to open up once again. Love is not lost from your life; you have just forgotten how you loved once upon a time. Let it all go; let your tears flow, your soul mend, and your heart create, once again.
 Cosmic tip: Dare to embark on this wonderful journey of life with an open heart once again.
